items.title: 18.7.1 Copper(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ligand exchange reactions of copper(II) (PDF 28).

blocks.text: Cu2+(aq) ka asal matlab complex ion [Cu(H2O)6]2+ hai, jo copper(II) ke namkon ke mehlool, jaise copper sulphate ke mehlool, ko neela rang deta hai.

blocks.caption: Copper(II) ke ligand exchange reactions
rows: neele mehlool se halka neela precipitate; do OH- do H2O ki jagah
precipitate ghul kar gehra neela mehlool
neele se gehra neela; chaar NH3 chaar H2O ki jagah

blocks.alt: Teen test tubes: beech mein neela [Cu(H2O)6]2+ ('yahan se shuru'); conc. HCl use peele-hare [CuCl4]2- (tetrahedral) aur conc. NH3 gehre neele [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ (octahedral) mein badalta hai. Neeche NaOH [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] ka halka neela precipitate deta hai, aur octahedral ammine ion ka khaaka: chaar NH3 aik plane mein aur do H2O oopar neeche.
blocks.caption: Copper(II) complexes ke ligand exchange aur rang ki tabdeeliyan (Figures 18.7 aur 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Neele hexaaquacopper(II) ion se shuru kar ke mukhtalif ligands mukhtalif rang dete hain. Do hydroxide ions do paani ke molecules ki jagah le kar halka neela precipitate dete hain, jo zaid ammonia mein ghul jata hai. Ammonia chaar paani ke molecules ki jagah le kar gehra neela [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ deta hai, aik octahedral ion jis mein chaar NH3 square mein aur do H2O axis par hain. Garha hydrochloric acid chhe paani ki jagah chaar chloride ions la kar peela-hara tetrahedral [CuCl4]2- deta hai; paani milane se yeh ulat jata hai.

blocks.title: Aasan formula
blocks.text: [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ ko aksar sirf [Cu(NH3)4]2+ likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Copper(II) mehlool mein zaid ammonia milane par gehra neela rang kaun sa complex ion deta hai?

items: NH3 se gehra neela [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+; conc. HCl se peela-hara [CuCl4]2-.
